findings.text: `Resolved.Statement.createsBySchema` matches over `Resolved.Statement` with a catch-all `| _ => false`, so a new statement constructor compiles without a decision on whether it is a schema-only creation. Fix: list every remaining `Resolved.Statement` constructor explicitly with `false`, or restrict the function to the four creation constructors and make the caller in `succeedsBySchema` handle the others.

The new module has no module docstring (`/-! ... -/`) that says why it exists, unlike every other module in `Programs/Scripts`. Fix: add a module docstring that says the module proves schema-only success for catalog creations and DROP COLUMN, so that `succeedsBySchema` can certify these steps.

The status file still says "The implementation and acceptance checks are pending", but the paragraph after it records the finished implementation and its tests. Fix: change that sentence so that only the slice review and checks are pending, or delete it.

The module docstring still says that the file checks a transaction and a foreign-key check, but this commit adds checks for view, trigger and index creation, DROP COLUMN and the UNIQUE index case. Fix: extend the module docstring to name the new creation, DROP COLUMN and UNIQUE-index checks.
